dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: All of you, please get out of here and find somewhere safe!

dialogues.speaker: Moseis
dialogues.text: I am the master of this dream. I can create endless waves of monsters with the snap of a finger.

dialogues.speaker: Moseis
dialogues.text: Don't worry. They'll wake up before they get hurt. Emira doesn't like to see others in pain.

dialogues.speaker: Moseis
dialogues.text: If you know what's good for you, leave now.
